scope: CPU-only level-batched product trees sharing the existing prepared DD chain. Pairing, rounded rescaling and odd-leaf reduction match the original per-tree evaluator.
checks: Random nonzero gadget fixtures and full, odd-sized and single-leaf trees produce byte-identical results to individual productTree calls.
Empty batches return no roots and invalid empty/overlong trees are rejected before multiplication.
Prepared-backend lookup failures propagate after joining parallel pair work.
Batched mode rejects a missing backend, stays outside key archives, resets on load, and clears when the staged policy replaces the backend.
Existing exact factor, tail alignment and bounded column tests remain passing.
key_cache_policy: Single-tree and batch evaluators capture the same prepared chain; no duplicate preparation or encryption occurs.
memory_policy: Release completed input levels before recursing into the next batch level.
